question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Strong taste or liking for something
solution:
The correct answer is: **Penchant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Penchant **means a strong or habitual liking for something or tendency to do something. (किसी चीज के लिए प्रबल या अभ्यस्त पसंद या कुछ करने की प्रवृत्ति)
 
• So, it is clear that '**Penchant**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**Strong taste or liking for something**'

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Insolvent **means unable to pay debts owed. (बकाया कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ)
 
• **Parole **means permission for a prisoner to be released before their period in prison is finished, with the agreement that they will behave well. (जेल में उनकी अवधि समाप्त होने से पहले एक कैदी को रिहा करने की अनुमति)
 
• **Ebullient** means cheerful and full of energy. (हंसमुख और ऊर्जा से भरपूर)
